source.code:
/-- Lift a map `f : α → β` to `WithBot α → WithBot β`. Implemented using `Option.map`. -/
@[to_dual
/-- Lift a map `f : α → β` to `WithTop α → WithTop β`. Implemented using `Option.map`. -/]
def map (f : α → β) : WithBot α → WithBot β :=
  Option.map f
